info.name: Zamna Ready To Fly Session Start API
Initiate MultiPax session with encrypted booking id, get session token to authorize further requests

params.name: consented
params.description: Whether consent should be set for session, true/false

params.name: pax_ids
params.description: Comma-separated list of pax ids to load from booking (if not specified, all pax will be loaded)

params.name: encryption_mode
params.description: Encryption mode to use for booking id decryption. If omitted used the only one configured, or else AES_CBC if multiple modes are configured.

items.docs: Initiate MultiPax session with encrypted booking id, get session token to authorize further requests
